title: Hook the candidate pipeline: a decide-relevance sweep that decides, syncs reviews and writes status
description:
Add papyrus references decide-relevance --corpus-key K [--apply] [--max-count N] in src/papyrus_content. Under an exclusive claim on a cyclotron.relevance Assignment, it restores the engine store from the media bucket, finds current pending References with no current decision (created by intake_research_packet_proposals in assignments_workflow.py and build_reference_catalog_registration_records in catalog.py, plus email submissions), builds an item (id = Reference lineageId; title, source URI and domain, ingestion rationale, summary or opening text, published date, discovering assignment and section), calls decide, and writes the decision relation. It then reads reference_curation Messages since its cursor, maps them to labels, calls review with selected_by program or reviewer, writes the status snapshot, and snapshots the store back. Run it after research-intake-now in the dispatch automation and on a schedule. Uses the Cyclotron SDK facade (decision-flywheel-0736e4a0) and portable store (decision-flywheel-f0285316). Ordering: after the data model task and those engine tasks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dry run is the default and prints the plan; --apply writes; reruns are no-ops for unchanged items and versions.
- Never changes curationStatus in phase one.
- A second concurrent sweep exits before any model call.
- Specs use a fake decision model and a fake GraphQL client; a live smoke on one sandbox publication is recorded in the issue.

comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-7a1ca2-cyclotron-intake-hook (built on PPY-4ac3d0): src/papyrus_content/relevance_sweep.py and 'papyrus references decide-relevance [--apply]'. Claim via the cyclotron.relevance Assignment (AssignmentClaimLease over apply_assignment_action), store restore/save in the private bucket (S3SnapshotStore), reviews from reference_curation Messages by the scope-training rule (message id as review id), decisions for all current pending references (listReferencesByCurationStatusKeyAndUpdatedAt added to the Python index definitions), status snapshot as KnowledgeRawPayload. Never changes curationStatus. Spec: features_backend/cyclotron-relevance-sweep.feature (story PPY-d478b1, 6 scenarios: decide and record, fresh worker without repeated model calls, review reaches the cyclotron, non-relevance review closes without a label, claimed by another worker, dry run). No new pytest/BDD failures. Notes: the claim is read-check-write (as Papyrus claims are today), and reviewed references are rescanned each sweep (idempotent; a cursor is a later optimization). Live smoke on a sandbox publication not yet run: needs a sandbox with the relevanceCyclotron block and a TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

right_now_summary: The relevance sweep is implemented and specified; only the live sandbox smoke test remains.
